```{=html}
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;600;700;800&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap');

  :root {
    --bg-deep: #0b0418;
    --bg-card: rgba(24, 12, 48, 0.85);
    --bg-card-hover: rgba(36, 18, 72, 0.95);
    --neon-pink: #ff2a85;
    --electric-blue: #00e5ff;
    --neon-green: #00f59b;
    --neon-yellow: #ffe600;
    --text-main: #f8f7ff;
    --text-muted: #b8aed2;
    --border-glow: rgba(255, 42, 133, 0.35);
  }

  body {
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 15% 10%, #240b4c 0%, #0b0418 45%, #06020e 100%) !important;
    color: var(--text-main) !important;
    font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif !important;
  }

  /* Hide default Quarto title block so our custom Hero shines */
  #title-block-header {
    display: none !important;
  }

  .hero-banner {
    position: relative;
    padding: 3.2rem 2rem;
    margin: 1rem 0 2.5rem 0;
    border-radius: 28px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,42,133,0.18) 0%, rgba(0,229,255,0.14) 50%, rgba(0,245,155,0.16) 100%),
                rgba(19, 8, 38, 0.9);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
    box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55), inset 0 0 40px rgba(255, 42, 133, 0.12);
    text-align: center;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .hero-badge {
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 0.35rem 1rem;
    border-radius: 999px;
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--neon-pink), var(--electric-blue));
    color: #0b0418;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
  }

  .hero-title {
    font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
    font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 5vw, 4.2rem);
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    margin: 0 0 0.6rem 0;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ffffff 0%, #ff7eb6 35%, #00e5ff 70%, #00f59b 100%);
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  }

  .hero-subtitle {
    font-size: 1.25rem;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  }

  .nav-pills-wrap {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.65rem;
    justify-content: center;
    margin-top: 1.2rem;
  }

  .nav-pill-link {
    text-decoration: none;
    padding: 0.55rem 1.15rem;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
    color: var(--text-main) !important;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 0.92rem;
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
  }

  .nav-pill-link:hover {
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--neon-pink), var(--electric-blue));
    color: #090314 !important;
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(255, 42, 133, 0.35);
  }

  .section-card {
    background: var(--bg-card);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.11);
    border-radius: 24px;
    padding: 2rem;
    margin-bottom: 2.2rem;
    box-shadow: 0 14px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  }

  .section-title {
    font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
    font-size: 1.85rem;
    font-weight: 800;
    margin-top: 0;
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.6rem;
  }

  .section-desc {
    color: var(--text-muted);
    font-size: 0.98rem;
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  }

  .flag-showcase {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(280px, 1.1fr) minmax(280px, 1fr);
    gap: 2rem;
    align-items: center;
    background: rgba(11, 4, 24, 0.65);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.25);
    border-radius: 22px;
    padding: 1.8rem;
    margin-top: 1.2rem;
  }

  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    .flag-showcase {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }
  }

  .flag-img-frame {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,0.08), rgba(0,0,0,0.4));
    border-radius: 18px;
    padding: 1.4rem;
    min-height: 240px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
  }

  .flag-img-frame img {
    max-width: 100%;
    max-height: 240px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65);
    transition: transform 0.3s ease;
  }

  .flag-img-frame img:hover {
    transform: scale(1.03);
  }

  .badge-tag {
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 0.3rem 0.85rem;
    border-radius: 999px;
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    margin-right: 0.5rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  }

  .badge-region {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.16);
    color: var(--electric-blue);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.4);
  }

  .badge-code {
    background: rgba(255, 42, 133, 0.16);
    color: #ff6b9d;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 42, 133, 0.4);
  }

  .btn-neon {
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0.65rem 1.3rem;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: none;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--neon-pink), #9b5de5);
    color: #fff;
    box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(255, 42, 133, 0.35);
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
  }

  .btn-neon:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: 0 10px 26px rgba(255, 42, 133, 0.55);
  }

  .btn-electric {
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0.65rem 1.3rem;
    border-radius: 12px;
    border: none;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--electric-blue), var(--neon-green));
    color: #080212;
    box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.3);
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
  }

  .btn-electric:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: 0 10px 26px rgba(0, 245, 155, 0.5);
  }

  .match-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(210px, 1fr));
    gap: 1.15rem;
    margin-top: 0.8rem;
  }

  .mini-flag-card {
    background: rgba(14, 6, 30, 0.85);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 1.1rem;
    text-align: center;
    transition: all 0.22s ease;
  }

  .mini-flag-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-4px);
    border-color: var(--electric-blue);
    box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2);
  }

  .mini-flag-card img {
    height: 92px;
    max-width: 100%;
    object-fit: contain;
    border-radius: 6px;
    margin-bottom: 0.7rem;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  }

  .sim-pill {
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem;
    border-radius: 999px;
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    font-weight: 800;
  }

  .sim-high {
    background: rgba(0, 245, 155, 0.18);
    color: var(--neon-green);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 245, 155, 0.45);
  }

  .sim-low {
    background: rgba(255, 42, 133, 0.18);
    color: #ff6b9d;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 42, 133, 0.45);
  }

  .quiz-option {
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 0.9rem 1.2rem;
    border-radius: 14px;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
    color: var(--text-main);
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 1rem;
    text-align: left;
    transition: all 0.18s ease;
    width: 100%;
  }

  .quiz-option:hover:not(:disabled) {
    background: rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.18);
    border-color: var(--electric-blue);
    transform: translateX(4px);
  }

  .quiz-option.correct {
    background: rgba(0, 245, 155, 0.25) !important;
    border-color: var(--neon-green) !important;
    color: #fff !important;
  }

  .quiz-option.wrong {
    background: rgba(255, 42, 133, 0.28) !important;
    border-color: var(--neon-pink) !important;
    color: #fff !important;
  }

  .kpi-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(170px, 1fr));
    gap: 1rem;
    margin-bottom: 1.6rem;
  }

  .kpi-box {
    background: rgba(11, 4, 24, 0.7);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 1.1rem;
    text-align: center;
  }

  .kpi-num {
    font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
    font-size: 2rem;
    font-weight: 800;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--neon-pink), var(--electric-blue));
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  }

  .color-bar-track {
    width: 100%;
    height: 22px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
    margin: 0.75rem 0 1rem 0;
  }

  /* Style Observable Inputs for dark neon look */
  form[class*="oi-"] {
    color: var(--text-main) !important;
    font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif !important;
  }
  form[class*="oi-"] select,
  form[class*="oi-"] input[type="text"] {
    background: #14082a !important;
    color: #ffffff !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.4) !important;
    border-radius: 10px !important;
    padding: 0.4rem 0.7rem !important;
  }
</style>

<div class="hero-banner">
  <div class="hero-badge">✨ Interactive Data Science Experience ✨</div>
  <h1 class="hero-title">🌍 FUN WITH FLAGS!</h1>

    <a class="nav-pill-link" href="#sec-zip">📦 ZIP Dataset Inspection</a>
  </div>
</div>
```

// Cosine similarity between two flags based on their 27-bin 3D RGB histogram + named color shares
function colorSimilarity(flagA, flagB) {
  const hA = flagA.hist;
  const hB = flagB.hist;
  let dot = 0, normA = 0, normB = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < hA.length; i++) {
    dot += hA[i] * hB[i];
    normA += hA[i] * hA[i];
    normB += hB[i] * hB[i];
  }
  const histSim = (normA > 0 && normB > 0) ? (dot / (Math.sqrt(normA) * Math.sqrt(normB))) : 0;

  // Also compare named color percentage vectors
  const colorNames = ["Red", "White", "Blue", "Light Blue", "Green", "Yellow", "Black", "Orange", "Maroon"];
  const mapA = new Map(flagA.colors.map(c => [c.name, c.pct]));
  const mapB = new Map(flagB.colors.map(c => [c.name, c.pct]));
  let cDot = 0, cNormA = 0, cNormB = 0;
  for (const name of colorNames) {
    const a = mapA.get(name) || 0;
    const b = mapB.get(name) || 0;
    cDot += a * b;
    cNormA += a * a;
    cNormB += b * b;
  }
  const namedSim = (cNormA > 0 && cNormB > 0) ? (cDot / (Math.sqrt(cNormA) * Math.sqrt(cNormB))) : 0;

  // Blended color similarity (0 to 100%)
  return Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (0.55 * histSim + 0.45 * namedSim) * 100));
}

  const inputEl = wrap.querySelector("input");

  inputEl.addEventListener("input", (e) => {
    mutable searchFilter = e.target.value;
    const q = e.target.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    const matches = flagsData.filter(d =>
      d.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      d.region.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      d.code.toLowerCase().includes(q)
    );
    if (matches.length > 0 && !matches.some(m => m.code === mutable selectedCode)) {
      mutable selectedCode = matches[0].code;
    }
  });

  selectEl.addEventListener("change", (e) => {
    mutable selectedCode = e.target.value;
  });

  btnEl.addEventListener("click", () => {
    mutable searchFilter = "";
    const pool = flagsData.filter(d => d.code !== mutable selectedCode);
    const pick = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
    mutable selectedCode = pick.code;
  });

  return wrap;
}

//| output: false
rankedMatches = {
  const others = flagsData
    .filter(d => d.code !== selectedFlag.code)
    .map(d => ({
      ...d,
      similarity: colorSimilarity(selectedFlag, d)
    }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.similarity - a.similarity);

  return {
    mostSimilar: others.slice(0, 3),
    mostDifferent: others.slice(-3).reverse()
  };
}

//| output: false
function makeQuestion(RoundSeed) {
  const answerIdx = Math.floor(Math.random() * flagsData.length);
  const correct = flagsData[answerIdx];
  const distractors = [];
  const used = new Set([correct.code]);
  while (distractors.length < 3) {
    const cand = flagsData[Math.floor(Math.random() * flagsData.length)];
    if (!used.has(cand.code)) {
      used.add(cand.code);
      distractors.push(cand);
    }
  }
  const options = [correct, ...distractors].sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5);
  return { correct, options };
}

mutable quizRound = 1
mutable quizScore = 0
mutable quizTotal = 0
mutable quizStreak = 0
mutable quizBestStreak = 0
mutable quizPicked = null
quizState = makeQuestion(quizRound)

quizUI = {
  const { correct, options } = quizState;
  const answered = quizPicked !== null;
  const isRight = quizPicked === correct.code;

  const box = html`<div style="background:rgba(11,4,24,0.68); border:1px solid rgba(255,42,133,0.3); border-radius:20px; padding:1.6rem;">
    <div style="display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:0.8rem; margin-bottom:1.2rem;">

          🏆 Score: ${quizScore} / ${quizTotal} (${quizTotal > 0 ? Math.round(100 * quizScore / quizTotal) : 0}%)
        </span>
        <span class="badge-tag" style="background:rgba(255,230,0,0.16); color:#ffe600; border:1px solid rgba(255,230,0,0.4); font-size:0.92rem;">
          🔥 Streak: ${quizStreak} (Best: ${quizBestStreak})
        </span>
      </div>
      <div style="display:flex; gap:0.6rem;">
        <button class="btn-electric" id="next-flag-btn" type="button">Next Flag ➡️</button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="flag-showcase" style="margin-top:0;">
      <div class="flag-img-frame" style="min-height:210px;">
        <img src="${correct.img}" alt="Mystery Flag" style="max-height:200px;" />
      </div>
      <div>
        <div style="font-weight:700; color:#b8aed2; margin-bottom:0.75rem; font-size:0.95rem;">
          Which country or territory belongs to this flag?
        </div>
        <div style="display:grid; gap:0.65rem;">
          ${options.map((opt, i) => {
            let cls = "quiz-option";
            if (answered) {
              if (opt.code === correct.code) cls += " correct";
              else if (opt.code === quizPicked) cls += " wrong";
            }
            return html`<button type="button" class="${cls}" data-opt="${opt.code}" ?disabled=${answered}>
              <span style="color:#00e5ff; font-weight:800; margin-right:0.5rem;">${["A", "B", "C", "D"][i]}.</span>
              ${opt.name}
            </button>`;
          })}
        </div>

        ${answered ? html`
          <div style="margin-top:1rem; padding:0.85rem 1.1rem; border-radius:12px; font-weight:700;
            background:${isRight ? 'rgba(0,245,155,0.18)' : 'rgba(255,42,133,0.2)'};
            border:1px solid ${isRight ? '#00f59b' : '#ff2a85'};
            color:${isRight ? '#00f59b' : '#ff85b3'};">
            ${isRight
              ? `🎉 Correct! That's the flag of ${correct.name} (${correct.region}).`
              : `❌ Not quite! That flag belongs to ${correct.name} (${correct.region}).`}
          </div>
        ` : html`<div style="margin-top:0.85rem; font-size:0.86rem; color:#b8aed2;">💡 Click an option above to lock in your answer!</div>`}
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>`;

  box.querySelectorAll(".quiz-option").forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      if (mutable quizPicked !== null) return;
      const code = btn.getAttribute("data-opt");
      mutable quizPicked = code;
      mutable quizTotal = mutable quizTotal + 1;
      if (code === correct.code) {
        mutable quizScore = mutable quizScore + 1;
        mutable quizStreak = mutable quizStreak + 1;
        if (mutable quizStreak > mutable quizBestStreak) {
          mutable quizBestStreak = mutable quizStreak;
        }
      } else {
        mutable quizStreak = 0;
      }
    });
  });

  box.querySelector("#next-flag-btn").addEventListener("click", () => {
    mutable quizPicked = null;
    mutable quizRound = mutable quizRound + 1;
  });

  return box;
}

```{ojs}
//| output: false
regionFlags = statsRegion === "All Regions"
  ? flagsData
  : flagsData.filter(d => d.region === statsRegion)

colorSummary = {
  const colorMeta = [
    { name: "Red", hex: "#ef233c" },
    { name: "White", hex: "#f8f9fa" },
    { name: "Blue", hex: "#1d4ed8" },
    { name: "Yellow", hex: "#facc15" },
    { name: "Green", hex: "#10b981" },
    { name: "Black", hex: "#52525b" },
    { name: "Light Blue", hex: "#38bdf8" },
    { name: "Orange", hex: "#f97316" },
    { name: "Maroon", hex: "#9f1239" }
  ];

  return colorMeta.map(cm => {
    let flagCount = 0;
    let totalPct = 0;
    for (const f of regionFlags) {
      const found = f.colors.find(c => c.name === cm.name);
      if (found) {
        flagCount += 1;
        totalPct += found.pct;
      }
    }
    return {
      color: cm.name,
      hex: cm.hex,
      flagCount,
      flagShare: regionFlags.length > 0 ? +(100 * flagCount / regionFlags.length).toFixed(1) : 0,
      avgCoverage: regionFlags.length > 0 ? +(totalPct / regionFlags.length).toFixed(1) : 0
    };
  }).sort((a, b) => b.flagCount - a.flagCount);
}

comboSummary = {
  const counts = new Map();
  for (const f of regionFlags) {
    const combo = f.colors.slice(0, 3).map(c => c.name).sort().join(" + ");
    if (combo) counts.set(combo, (counts.get(combo) || 0) + 1);
  }
  return Array.from(counts.entries())
    .map(([combo, count]) => ({ combo, count }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count)
    .slice(0, 8);
}

avgColorsPerFlag = (regionFlags.reduce((acc, f) => acc + f.colors.length, 0) / Math.max(1, regionFlags.length)).toFixed(1)
```

  wrap.querySelectorAll(".mini-flag-card").forEach(card => {

<div id="sec-zip" class="section-card">
  <h2 class="section-title">📦 Dataset & ZIP Archive Inspection</h2>
  <p class="section-desc">Summary of what we discovered inside <code>https://flagcdn.com/w2560.zip</code>:</p>
  <ul style="color:#d9d2e9; line-height:1.7; margin-bottom:0;">
    <li><strong>Total Files & Format:</strong> Contains <strong>254 PNG image files</strong> (<code>.png</code>) and no subdirectories or non-image files (4.1 MB compressed ZIP, 5.4 MB uncompressed).</li>
    <li><strong>Dimensions & Aspect Ratios:</strong> Every flag is rendered at a fixed width of <strong>2,560 pixels</strong> (<code>w2560</code>), while the height varies to preserve each flag's official aspect ratio—for example, United States (<code>us.png</code>) is <code>2560 × 1347</code>, Switzerland (<code>ch.png</code>) is a square <code>2560 × 2560</code>, and Nepal (<code>np.png</code>) is <code>2560 × 3121</code>.</li>
    <li><strong>Naming Convention:</strong> Files use lowercase two-letter <strong>ISO 3166-1 alpha-2</strong> country and territory codes (250 codes from <code>ad.png</code> to <code>zw.png</code>), plus 4 hyphenated codes for the constituent nations of the United Kingdom (<code>gb-eng.png</code>, <code>gb-nir.png</code>, <code>gb-sct.png</code>, and <code>gb-wls.png</code>).</li>
    <li><strong>Web Optimization:</strong> To keep this repository fast and GitHub Pages-friendly without committing multi-megabyte raw textures, all 254 PNGs were proportionally downsampled to <code>320px</code> width inside <code>flags/</code> after extracting their RGB color histograms.</li>
  </ul>
</div>
